name: Zoom-through transition

source.description: An inspected reel pushes the camera through a word on a tilted panel into the next space.

technique: The camera flies into an element (a letter counter, a window, a dot) until it passes the lens, and the next scene is found inside it.
purpose: Spatial continuity; 'going deeper' into a topic.
visual_behaviour: An element scales up rapidly with ease-in until its interior fills the frame; the next scene settles from slightly enlarged.
mechanics: Scale to 8-20x about an interior point with power3/expo.in; next scene from scale 1.15 to 1 with ease-out; brief overlap.
failure_modes: Scaling text to 20x blurs or costs raster time; switch at about 6x
Transform origin not on a hole or dark interior shows a flash

implementation.approach: Scale the outgoing scene about the target point (transformOrigin from Studio.boxAt), cut at cover, scale the incoming scene down from 1.15. Candidate Studio.fx.zoomThrough.

provenance.observed: A push through a word on a tilted panel leads into a dark space with a metallic sphere.
